high_level_description: The image appears to be taken at a fashion show or a similar event where models are walking on a wooden runway. The focus is on the lower half of a model's outfit, which includes a long, flowing denim skirt that extends well beyond the hemline, giving it an avant-garde look. The skirt is paired with black leggings underneath and brown shoes. The model is also wearing a textured, possibly tweed, jacket that is partially visible. In the background, there are other models and attendees, some of whom are partially visible.
